text: 玉渊谭天发表文章称，中国人民银行发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场，核心在于厘清三方面问题：一是汇率问题不应被政治化，更不能被用作抹黑他国的工具；二是部分国际组织的相关评估并非成员国共同商定结果，本质上属于一家之言，不应被奉为“金科玉律”或选择性引用；三是个别国家不应将自身经济结构性问题归咎于他国，通过“甩锅”转移责任，而应正视并解决自身问题。
text_en: Yuyuantantian published an article stating that the People's Bank of China released a policy stance on the RMB exchange rate, with the core focus on clarifying three issues: first, exchange rate issues should not be politicized, let alone used as a tool to smear other countries; second, relevant assessments by some international organizations are not jointly agreed upon by member states and essentially represent a single viewpoint, and should not be treated as "gospel" or selectively cited; third, individual countries should not blame their own structural economic problems on other countries and shift responsibility through "scapegoating," but should face up to and resolve their own problems.
